chunks: Yūnus, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who has intercourse with an animal, he said: He said, “There is no hadd punishment upon him, but there is taʿzīr.”

key_terms.بَهِيمَةٍ: an animal; the object involved in the prohibited act
key_terms.تَعْزِيرٌ: a discretionary punishment determined by authority
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the legal subject mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.يَقَعُ: has intercourse; here referring to committing the act

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shi'a hadith on a man who has intercourse with an animal?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who commits intercourse with an animal. It states that the fixed hadd punishment does not apply in this case, but discretionary punishment (taʿzīr) is imposed.
